messages:
Alice Nguyen: RC build ready from commit abc1234  artifact rc-2026-03-21-1. targeting promo window 09:00-11:00 UTC. pls ack pin + canary plan :raised_hands:
Ben Park: ack. pin requested. canary plan: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 30m if green.
Carla Ruiz: release notes updated: /docs/release-notes/rc-2026-03-21.md. includes small nullable DB migration, no schema lock.
sheriff-jen: i'm sheriff for the window. monitoring latency + error budgets. set me as contact on the ticket.
Alice Nguyen: @deploy-bot stage canary to us-east-1 and run smoke tests. add metadata rc=rc-2026-03-21-1 owner=alice
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: stage=canary region=us-east-1 artifact=rc-2026-03-21-1
deploy-bot: Canary deploy OK. smoke tests PASS. logs: https://logs.internal/r/rc-2026-03-21-1
Ben Park: baseline tail latency +5ms, token CPU stable. metrics look good.
Carla Ruiz: note: embedding service config bumped to v2 for quantized model. watch memory on embedders.
sheriff-jen: alert thresholds set: error >3% or latency >2x baseline for 5m -> rollback.
Alice Nguyen: schedule promo at 09:30 UTC if no alerts by 09:15.
Ben Park: pinning artifact: registry.pin("inference-service", "rc-2026-03-21-1")
Carla Ruiz: registry shows pin at 1763654400.
deploy-bot: Promo checklist: [artifact pinned] [canary passed] [sheriff assigned] [release notes linked] -> ready for promotion.
Alice Nguyen: executing promo now. @deploy-bot promote to prod-shard-1 and prod-shard-2 with stagger=10%
deploy-bot: Promotion started: shards=[prod-shard-1,prod-shard-2] initial=10%
deploy-bot: Progress: 10% -> 30% -> 60% (2m intervals). smoke checks running.
Ben Park: minor 500 spikes in europe-west-1 at 30% ramp, ~90s blip, trended back down. not exceeding alert.
sheriff-jen: holding until 60% completes. no manual rollback.
Carla Ruiz: applying a hot config tweak to embedder retry backoff + jitter to reduce transient 500s.
deploy-bot: Promotion reached 100% on prod-shard-1, 80% on prod-shard-2. finalizing.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. artifact rc-2026-03-21-1 is LIVE.
Alice Nguyen: releasing notes and marking RC promoted in docket. filing follow-up perf tweak tickets. :white_check_mark:
Ben Park: post-promo sanity: QPS +3%, cost stable, p99 unchanged. will monitor for 2 hours.
sheriff-jen: oncall will watch overnight. rollback criteria reiterated.
Carla Ruiz: rollback playbook pasted for quick exec:
```
# rollback steps
1) deploy-bot rollback --artifact previous-stable --target all
2) unpin rc-2026-03-21-1 in registry
3) revert embedder config if patch applied
4) post status page update + notify customers
```
Alice Nguyen: thanks team. closing RC thread. follow-ups: perf tickets and embedding mem investigation.
